Maltic's Well#000.src: Talk to Rynend located in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Maltic's Well#001.src: Please help us! We called for a {p} guard days ago, but Humans tend to forget this little village.
Maltic's Well#001.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#002.src: Last week, an evil witch found refuge in our old well. Normally this wouldn't be a problem...
Maltic's Well#002.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#003.src: But she's lured my child into the well! My only child! He was born in Wynn, that makes him a Wynn citizen!
Maltic's Well#003.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#004.src: Please do something! I know {p} isn't of importance to you humans, being a Villager settlement, but...my son!
Maltic's Well#004.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#005.src: Investigate the old {p} well at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [[Witch's Empty Bottle|[{~} Witch's Empty Bottle]]] to Rynend

Maltic's Well#006.src: Help me! Someone! The witch is being mean!!
Maltic's Well#006.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#007.src: I wondered when they'd send the famous {p} guards. You'll never get me!
Maltic's Well#007.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#008.src: I don't know why they call me a witch. Magic is everywhere, you know. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!
Maltic's Well#008.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#009.src: Treat me like a witch, I'll act like one, darn it! You'll have to pass through my dastardly magical defenses to find me!
Maltic's Well#009.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#010.src: Oh...drat. I never could get that spell right. Well, now you'll have to guess the way, um, you fool! Turn back now, for, uh...
Maltic's Well#010.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#011.src: ...for if you choose the wrong door, you'll be sent to a beast, a beast most foul! The, um...the Beast-What-Eats-{p}-Guards-For-Brunch!! Totally!
Maltic's Well#011.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#012.src: Oh...didn't think that'd fool you. You know, I'm really not all that good at magic. I just like wearing pointy hats, and have warts.
Maltic's Well#012.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#013.src: Maybe if the people of this village weren't so mean to me, I wouldn't have been forced to live here.
Maltic's Well#013.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#014.src: I know it's a crime, but his father and the rest of the villagers here hunt me like I'm a rabid dog!
Maltic's Well#014.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#015.src: I wasn't really going to turn this boy into a Grook. I doubt I could even make him grow one feather. I mean, watch...
Maltic's Well#015.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#017.src: ...oh my gosh it worked???? It worked, I did a spell for once in my miserable life!!
Maltic's Well#017.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#018.src: W-Wait, that's not good at all, you're gonna... No! You won't take me out of here alive!
Maltic's Well#018.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#019.src: Thank you for saving me from the witch... She was nice at first and made me cookies, but I want to go home now.
Maltic's Well#019.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#020.src: Oh my son! What happened down there? Erh, not a witch, you say?
Maltic's Well#020.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#021.src: Preposterous! She wore a hat and had warts! I guess it's too late now... Thank you so much for your help.
Maltic's Well#021.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#022.src: I have very little to offer you as reward... I hope my appreciation will be more than enough!
Maltic's Well#022.speaker: Rynend
